title: fs-dir tests: dynamic inotify (add/remove after init)
description: Test the inotify path: (1) call C_Initialize with empty dir, then write slot-0.p11k into the dir, assert C_WaitForSlotEvent fires and slot 0 appears; (2) start with slot-0.p11k present, delete it, assert C_WaitForSlotEvent fires and slot 0 disappears. Use short timeout (500ms) to keep test suite fast. Guard with WOLFP11_CFG_TEST_INOTIFY if timing is too fragile for CI.
